load_objs: load rigid objects into a Habitat-Sim simulation with specified transformations and motion types
load_articulated_objs: load articulated URDF objects into a Habitat-Sim simulation with fixed or free base settings
add_obj: add a single box or config-based object to a Habitat-Sim simulation and return its object ID
place_viz_objs: place wireframe visualization objects in a Habitat-Sim simulation matching associated object bounding boxes
init_art_objs: initialize articulated object joint positions and default velocity motor settings in a Habitat-Sim simulation
